title: Legal perimeter: strictly arm's length by construction
summary: VMM is its own legal entity, books, capital, execution state and risk authority. Federation may lend or trade with VMM only through explicit arm's-length contracts and queue protocols; there is no shared customer balance, principal book or inherited customer identity channel.
invariants: Federation Core/Retail funding is an explicit facility/loan, not account access.
Federation Merchant flow crosses a durable anonymised RFQ/execution Queue Fabric boundary.
Direct institutional OTC business is a separate VMM counterparty perimeter and not the Federation RFQ channel.
Raw institutional portfolio positions do not cross into venue execution commands.

provenance.claim: VMM legal perimeter, arm-length Federation relationships and direct institutional separation.
